'''Tokkat''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="rotj" /> and later independently served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]].<ref name="Gamer" />

==Biography==
Tokkat and his brother [[Wunka/Legends|Wunka]] were born in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the brothers were among several other Ewoks who chose to leave the Forest Moon with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Upon joining [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] civilization, they quickly adapted and joined the New Republic Defense Fleet. Tokkat learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] in a somewhat squeaky voice, and became proficient in the use of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="GatORW" />

The brothers eventually took positions as gunners on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']]. Tokkat and Wunka were present when the ''Liberator'' [[Second Battle of Coruscant|crashed]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They bravely defended the surviving crew on the ground.<ref name="GatORW" />

Wunka was later killed in a [[Skirmish on Holageus|skirmish]] on [[Holageus]], and Tokkat took his body back to Endor for burial. Rather than returning to the fleet, he then retired on the Forest Moon. As an honored hunter of Bright Tree Village, he served as its unofficial ambassador to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tokkat was played by [[Margo Apostolos]] in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="CIVOPAGL">{{WebCite|url=http://officialpix.com/OPX/Celebrities.html|text=Celebration IV Official Pix Autograph Guest List|archivedate=20071015144459}}</ref>

In 2004, [[Hasbro]] released an unnamed figure based on Tokkat with a [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|pack=Ewok with Attack Glider|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw04ultraewok.asp}}</ref> [[The LEGO Group]] sold a minifigure of Tokkat in [[2011]] along with [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]. The LEGO Tokkat had black fur and a dark green hood. It also appropriately included a bow and arrow.
